Software license does not establish financial-data redistribution rights.

No production source switch, product dependency change, global network/proxy change, or final-holdout evaluation performed in this research. AKShare was installed only in an isolated verification environment.
Raw daily samples and calendar were obtained; adjustment consistency, tradability, historical universe and batch/concurrent/longitudinal stability remain unaccepted.
New worker, API, Vue components and one-minute service targets are plans, not implemented product capabilities.
